Run an analysis from an analysis plan

Source: R/analysis_plan.R
run_analysis.Rd

Method execution is intentionally delegated to handler functions. This prevents run_analysis() from silently substituting a different statistical method when the requested method is unavailable or assumptions fail.

Usage

run_analysis(data, plan, handlers = list(), allow_override = TRUE)

Arguments

data

Analysis data.

plan

A statistical_analysis_plan object.

handlers

Named list of analysis handler functions. Each handler must accept `data`, `plan`, and `selection`.

allow_override

Whether an explicit plan method may override guidance.

Value

An object of class "environmental_analysis_result".
